name: Torrent Gold Inc.
summary: Torrent Gold Inc. engages in the exploration and development of mineral assets throughout Canada and the United States. The company primarily targets deposits containing silver, gold, copper, zinc, and other base metals. Its portfolio includes a stake in the Clover Mountain property, which consists of 43 claims spanning 350 hectares, situated southeast of Boise, Idaho. Furthermore, Torrent Gold fully owns several properties within Nevada's Great Basin: the Anchor property, comprising 54 unpatented federal lode claims; the Stateline property, with 94 unpatented federal lode claims; and the Sandy property, also encompassing 54 unpatented federal lode claims. Founded in 2018, the company was formerly known as Raindrop Ventures Inc. before adopting the name Torrent Gold Inc. in April 2022, and it is headquartered in Boise, Idaho.
